items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: No, we didn't. ... But the rest of people in the show, we didn't come into any contact.

ctx.x: And you know Cab being so popular, we didn't have any days off, we got through with that we had to come right on back to work.
What about people like Bing Crosby and Eddie Lang, and those other people who were involved in that same film, did you get together with them at all?
No, we didn't. Bing was very friendly.
